verdict.rationale: Kit is an email-marketing and creator SaaS platform. Its documented MCP offerings (the Kit MCP and the Kit Developer Docs MCP) are servers that expose Kit data and docs to outside AI clients, which is the opposite role from this story. Nothing in the evidence shows Kit running an agent or AI client that consumes tools from MCP servers, so the client axis does not apply, and the server-side evidence earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
